verdict: Visual roles and owner procedure are consistent; hosted Linux functional/capture evidence is complete. Hardware/default-launcher playfeel and performance acceptance are not granted by this addendum.
scope: Read-only review of retained exact-source Linux evidence and canonical owner instructions. No tests, application interactions, source edits or audit edits were performed by the reviewer.

gallery.selection_recommendation: Include all four in order. If space allows only three inline, use overview, inspector and takeover, and retain handback as a linked fourth frame. Caption fourth as policy restored with Observer/no pilot, not as Midge retaken automatically.

owner_usability.visual_result: The main toolbar and all actor-panel controls fit the captured viewport and are readable. Selection and human piloting are visibly independent. No concrete visual role/ownership defect was observed.
owner_usability.minor_clarification: The upper Family/Model picker chooses a model to place or replace; the Inspect picker selects an existing actor whose controller/equipment/status appears below. In the inspector PNG these are Midge and Crawler respectively.
owner_usability.procedure_verified: Actor Composition -> Mixed Actor Workshop -> Play; Inspect without takeover; Pilot inspected -> Hand back -> explicitly pilot Midge; per-actor Controller/Decisions enabled; mounted item restart separate from live handoff; running Brush/Eraser versus paused precise editing/history; External submissions and fresh local test action; named authored Save/Load; disabled flyer mount selector and capacity refusal.
not_proved_by_still_images: Per-command freshness or exact RID preservation

functional_support.display_scope: Both functional receipts are explicitly headless; graphical screenshots are a separate actual X11 application execution.

performance.instrumentation_gap: The harness samples copied-observation cost only every 30 process frames (measure_workbench_actor_composition.gd:105–108). Each three-second graphical row produced 16–17 frames, so no observation timing was captured. count 0 means unmeasured, not zero cost.
performance.interpretation: The hosted software-rendered run demonstrates progression and functional completion, not smooth gameplay. No accepted-main graphical control is included, so it does not establish regression or equivalence against main. Prior headless timings must remain separately identified. Reported native publication duration is not an end-to-end render scheduling/stall measurement; short 16–17-frame quantiles and process-cumulative Godot static memory are not broad hardware acceptance.

remaining_issues_and_boundaries: Hosted graphical copied-observation timing is absent because the sampler never reached its frame interval.
This llvmpipe run is visibly too slow to serve as smooth owner-playfeel acceptance; genuine GPU/default-launcher evaluation remains required.
The screenshots do not themselves demonstrate pause, painting or persistence; cite the independently retained functional receipts for those assertions.
No Windows execution or portable-default-renderer claim is established by this Linux-only review.
No global route planning, learned model service, sampled representation or unrestricted Thunderbowl semantics are implied by these role labels.
